description: Markov-trace assembly chain for the proton: combines schur-weyl-weight-3 + hoefsmit-rep-21-sigma1 + atomic-braid-recipe-p chains via the finite-Jones axiom into tr_M(p, q_0) ≈ 2.1226.  Trust profile is {axiom: 1, mathlib: 0, derived: 4, script: 1, computational: 1} — closes 4 of 5 SCRIPT_CITED steps in the proton atom-tr-M-q0 chain.  Remaining script-frontier covers w_(2,1) and w_(1,1,1) Wedderburn weights, which need their own per-λ chains (analogous to schur-weyl-weight-3 but for partitions (2,1) and (1,1,1)).

steps.name: Partitions of 3 — Schur–Weyl basis at A=1
steps.operation: By Schur–Weyl duality, the Markov-trace decomposition for an A=1 atom (n = 3·A = 3) sums over partitions λ ⊢ 3.  The three partitions are (3), (2,1), (1,1,1) with frame dimensions f_λ = 1, 2, 1.

steps.name: Wedderburn weight w_(3)(q) — chain reference
steps.operation: Reference the existing `schur-weyl-weight-3.derivation.json` chain, target w_(3)(q) = (q − q^{-1})² / ([3]_q · [2]_q · [1]_q).  This step is DERIVED via the chain reference.
steps.notes: Derivation chain: schur-weyl-weight-3.derivation.json (builder: build_schur_weyl_weight_chain.py).  Fully-trusted (0 SCRIPT_CITED in that chain).

steps.name: Wedderburn weights w_(2,1)(q), w_(1,1,1)(q)
steps.operation: For partitions other than (3), the Wedderburn weights follow the same Schur formula but with hook-length sets {3, 1, 1} for (2,1) and {3, 2, 1} for (1,1,1).  Per-λ chains for these are not yet shipped; remains SCRIPT_CITED until the chain set is complete.
steps.notes: script: folio-assistant/computations/schur_weyl_symbolic.py function `schur_weyl_weight(lam, q)`.  SCRIPT_CITED — per-λ schur-weyl-weight chains for (2,1) and (1,1,1) are pending.

steps.name: Trivial rep χ^(3)_q on proton braid word
steps.operation: The trivial rep λ=(3) is 1-dimensional.  Each generator σ_i acts as multiplication by +q (Hoefsmit recipe in the 1-cell column).  For the proton's 6-crossing word T_w_p, χ^(3)_q(T_w_p) = q^{n_+ − n_−} where n_± count the σ vs σ⁻¹ appearances.  All proton crossings are positive σ → χ^(3)_q(T_w_p) = q^6.
steps.notes: 1-dim rep; trace is a monomial in q.  No script needed.  Atomic-braid recipe (atomic-braid-recipe-p chain) supplies the n_±=6/0 count.

steps.name: Hoefsmit rep χ^(2,1)_q on proton braid word
steps.operation: Reference the existing `hoefsmit-rep-21-sigma1.derivation.json` chain for ρ^(2,1)(σ_1) and its trace; extend by braid-word matrix multiplication to the full T_w_p word (six σ-crossings alternating σ_1, σ_2).  The character χ^(2,1)_q(T_w_p) is the trace of the resulting 2x2 matrix product.
steps.notes: Derivation chain: hoefsmit-rep-21-sigma1.derivation.json (builder: build_hoefsmit_rep_chain.py).  For the proton the matrix product is over 6 σ-generators; chain-extension applies the same recipe iteratively.

steps.name: Sign rep χ^(1,1,1)_q on proton braid word
steps.operation: The sign rep λ=(1,1,1) is 1-dimensional.  Each generator σ_i acts as multiplication by −q^{-1} (Hoefsmit recipe in the 1-cell column).  For the proton's positive 6-crossing word, χ^(1,1,1)_q(T_w_p) = (−q^{-1})^6 = q^{-6}.

steps.name: Finite-Jones Markov-trace assembly
steps.operation: tr_M(T_w_p, q) = w_(3)(q) · χ^(3)_q(T_w_p) + w_(2,1)(q) · χ^(2,1)_q(T_w_p) + w_(1,1,1)(q) · χ^(1,1,1)_q(T_w_p).  Uniqueness of this assembly is the **finite-Jones** axiom: Markov stabilisation tr_M(α σ_n) = z · tr_M(α) determines the trace uniquely on the closure of every braid word.
steps.output_value: symbolic Laurent polynomial in q (proton Markov trace)

steps.name: Evaluate tr_M(p, q_0) at q_0 ≈ 1.1099785956
steps.operation: Substitute q := q_0 into the symbolic assembly; mpmath at 50 dps gives 2.12258250945273... matching the upstream atom-tr-M-q0 chain leaf and term6-full-pole-sum.witness.json (rel_diff = 0).
steps.notes: COMPUTATIONAL leaf — bare numerical eval.  Cross-checked at machine precision against habiro-coefficients-atomic, markov-substrate-realization, and term6-full-pole-sum (rel_diff ≤ 1e-12 across all paths).
